description: This bar chart illustrates the execution accuracy of two text-to-SQL generation methods, NatSQL and TA-SQL, across four categories: Simple, Moderate, Challenging, and Total. The vertical axis, labeled "Execution Accuracy," is scaled linearly from 20 to 60, with tick marks at intervals of 10, and the horizontal axis lists the four categories in left-to-right order. For each category, two adjacent bars are displayed: a light blue bar representing NatSQL and a darker blue bar representing TA-SQL, as indicated by the legend. The values are explicitly labeled on top of each bar. In the "Simple" category, NatSQL achieves an accuracy of 60.21 and TA-SQL achieves 63.14. In the "Moderate" category, NatSQL scores 39.64 and TA-SQL scores 48.60. In the "Challenging" category, NatSQL scores 32.32 and TA-SQL scores 36.11. For the "Total" category, NatSQL achieves 51.35 and TA-SQL achieves 56.19. The bars are not sorted and are presented in the order of the categories listed on the x-axis. There are no visual emphasis or annotations beyond the value labels on top of each bar.
